messages.author: b92b975ecf3476be
messages.subject: Only first tabPanel displays content
parts:
Hi all,

I am a newbie with Shiny.  I guess my question is intended to Shiny developers.

I wrote a Shiny app which runs perfectly on my local machine.
I'm not deploying it yet.  I'm trying and running the same exact app on a remote server, and there, only the first "tabPanel" displays anything (be it what's expected or an error message).
It seems the display of output is simply off for second, third, nth tabPanels.

In my ui.R, I can swap outputs, e.g.:

tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Title 1", htmlOutput("content_2")),
      tabPanel("Title 2", htmlOutput("content_1"))

vs.

tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Title 1", htmlOutput("content_1")),
      tabPanel("Title 2", htmlOutput("content_2"))

And really the content is not the issue, it's just that it shows only when it's in the first tabPanel.

I read the post with subject "Re: only first tab on tabsetPanel loads if submitButton is used" because it sounded like a similar issue...
So I'll try installing the latest Github version of Shiny...

Thanks in advance for your help!

Marianne
